simple.meaning: שְׁמַד (shᵉmad) is a Hebrew action word meaning “consume.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 1 time in Daniel, beginning at Daniel 7:26. Its meaning becomes clearer as the uses are compared.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to שְׁמַד (H8046) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: שְׁמַד (shᵉmad) / H8046 is traced through Daniel 7:26 with source-language evidence and verse context.

definitions.full: H8046. shmad [ שְׁמַד ] verb Haph`el destroy ( ᵑ7 Pa`el make apostatize ; compare Biblical Hebrew); — Infinitive לְהַשְׁמָדָה Dan 7:26 (object omitted, = dominion).
